department: Department of Physics (College of Arts & Sciences)

deadline.value: Fall (domestic and international) applicants: December 1. A separate January 1 date applies to assistantship consideration; no year is printed on either.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Subject test in Physics is recommended, not required, and no minimum is used.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Subject Test is recommended, but not required

supervisor.value: Applications are judged by the Admissions Committee; the supervisor is appointed in the first year, after admission.
supervisor.quote: The Admissions Committee evaluates all credentials submitted by applicants

also.quote: are expected to complete both the Supervisor Appointment and Plan of Study tabs

funding.value: The page advertises fellowships with 12-month stipends but does not say that most or all students receive them.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's is the minimum, and students may also be admitted with post-master's status.
entry_route.quote: Admission for graduate study at Drexel University requires a four-year bachelor's degree

also.quote: Students who are admitted for PhD study with "post-masters" status must take 15 credits of graduate coursework

app_fee.value: The physics page states an application fee of $65 U.S.
app_fee.quote: Please note, an application fee of $65 U.S. is required.

gre_general.value: GRE General is recommended, not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are recommended, but not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL internet test minimum 100 (the page also lists 600 paper and 250 computer scores).

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 7.0 is the physics minimum.

notes: Also covers Astronomy & Astrophysics: the PhD lists an 'Astrophysics (Experimental and Theoretical)' concentration on the official how-to-apply page. Assistantship consideration date January 1 (no year printed). The admissions table cells (PhD Dec. 1) are split, so the list line on the doctorate page is quoted instead. Physics handbook: post-master's students take 15 credits before candidacy.
